messages:
Maya SRE: heads-up — we had a DB replica lag alert at 09:18 UTC that posted to #incidents but did NOT page the oncall. inc-bot shows delivery to channel but no outbound page attempts in pagerflow logs :rotating_light:
inc-bot: automated: alert 'db-replica-lag' posted to #incidents at 09:18:27, attempted paging hook invoked, webhook response: 403 Forbidden from pagerflow, pages blocked: 0 delivered
Jorge: I didn't get any page or SMS. I was available — phone shows no incoming attempts.
Priya: oncall routing shows pagerflow returned 403 for the outbound webhook. Can someone paste the raw webhook response and headers?
Maya SRE: logs attached below (sanitized). looks like our proxy stripped the incoming `X-Signature` header on the outbound call to pagerflow: 
```
POST /v1/page HTTP/1.1
Host: pagerflow.internal
User-Agent: inc-bot/2.3.0
Content-Type: application/json
# expected: X-Signature: sha256=...
# actual: <missing>
Response: 403 Forbidden
{"error":"signature missing"}
```
Priya: ah — header strip. We rolled the ingress proxy yesterday: `envoy/proxy` had `strip_headers: ["X-Signature"]` in one cluster config during a partial rollout. That would break signed webhooks.
Jorge: confirmed — I see the same 403 events in pagerflow dashboard, signature-missing. No retries because pagerflow rejects outright.
Alicia (oncall): I'm oncall now — missed the page. I'll escalate manually (SMS -> phone tree). Starting manual ringdown.
Maya SRE: starting mitigation checklist: 1) revert proxy config on the routing cluster 2) re-trigger any pending webhooks 3) if proxy rollback isn't fast, enable fallback routing (`pager-legacy`) for outbound pages.
Priya: rollback command I ran in staging: `kubectl patch configmap envoy-cluster -p '{"data":{"strip_headers":""}}'` — in prod we need an approval. If ops cannot approve quickly, do fallback route.
Maya SRE: ops-runbook-bot attempted to attach runbook to the incident but failed — automation couldn't generate runbook link because the alert payload lacked `service_id` (that's a downstream metadata regression).
ops-runbook-bot: automated: failed to attach runbook: missing `service_id` in alert. To attach manually run: `ops-runbook attach --alert-id=AZ12345 --runbook=runbooks/db-replica-lag`
Jorge: manual escalation in progress. I'm pinging the SRE rotation group and starting a dojo call. Alicia, can you confirm phone escalation sequence?
Alicia (oncall): SMS sent to primary, then call to cell -> house -> alt. I've also opened a PagerDuty manual page as a fallback.
deploy-bot: CI note: proxy config rollout at 07:12 UTC to cluster `edge-eu-1` included header strip change by roll #4821.
Maya SRE: suggested short-term play: toggle a feature flag to route `inc-bot` webhooks to `pager-legacy` (no signature check) while we rollback proxy. Command: `POST /admin/route-toggle {"source":"inc-bot","target":"pager-legacy"}` (ops API).
Priya: I'll open an ops approval ticket and start the rollback; ETA ~8-12min for config rollback if no blocker. If rollback fails, we'll enable the fallback route.
Jorge: FYI customer-impact: a handful of users on the affected DB shard saw elevated latency for ~5m. No sustained errors reported, but we need a short customer message in status with root cause (outbound paging automation failure caused delayed mitigation).
Alicia (oncall): I'll draft the status blurb: "Investigating — paging automation to on-call interrupted due to signed webhook validation failure. Mitigation: manual escalation and config rollback in progress. We will follow up with timeline and impact."
Maya SRE: after rollback, we need to re-send the alert webhook to pagerflow so it attempts re-delivery (pagerflow doesn't accept replays for old IDs). Quick command to re-trigger: `inc-bot replay --alert-id=AZ12345 --to=pagerflow`
Priya: rollback succeeded on `edge-eu-1`, removing `strip_headers` across the canary. Watching logs for re-attempts.
inc-bot: automated: replay invoked for alert AZ12345, outbound call returned 200 OK, page attempt sent to oncall endpoint.
Jorge: I got a missed page notification from inc-bot replay, confirmed phone call arrived at 09:26. Good. :thumbsup:
Alicia (oncall): Status blurb posted to status.redwood.ai and sent to customers affected.
Maya SRE: postmortem action items: - prevent config with header stripping during webhook rollouts (validation gate) - add synthetic test that sends signed webhook through proxy in pre-prod - fallback route healthcheck and automated toggle runbook - ensure alert payload includes `service_id` for runbook attachments
Priya: filing the follow-up and tagging infra/config teams. Thanks all for quick pivots.
Jorge: marking incident as mitigated for paging failure; continuing to monitor DB shard lag until fully recovered.
Alicia (oncall): switching off manual ringdown; reassigning followups to SRE postmortem thread. :white_check_mark:
